deck.comment: The fixed deck of 12 illustrated fortune cards. art_key + title + theme + numeral are the card's identity and never change — one illustration per art_key at public/art/{art_key}.png. The deck is the whole catalogue every day; Gemini rewrites only the words each night. The Golden Empress carries the money theme (abundance).

art.comment: The 12 real illustrations live in public/art/{art_key}.jpg (704x1056, q82 — resized from the 1024x1536 masters), served by the app itself (baseUrl 'art' is relative). Point baseUrl at a CDN instead to serve them from elsewhere. If a file is missing the client falls back to its inline placeholder emblem.

astrologer.comment: avatarUrl is the astrologer's portrait shown beside the consult nudge. Served from public/ (relative) or a CDN. If the file is missing the client falls back to an inline placeholder.
astrologer.name: Pandit ji

sampleDeck.title: The Radiant Sun
fortune: The clouds of the last few days are quietly moving aside for you.
In the coming days your energy will feel new again, and lighter.
sampleDeck.finding: Your strength is returning. Where to spend it first is the one thing this card leaves open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which work truly deserves this new energy? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Radiant Sun' card today. What does it mean for me?

sampleDeck.title: The Guiding Star
fortune: A hope you had almost put down is going to come back to you this week.
The way ahead is being lit for you, gently, one small step at a time.
sampleDeck.finding: Hope is coming back to you. Which hope is worth walking towards is still to be understood.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which hope is truly worth walking towards? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Guiding Star' card today. What does it mean for my future?

sampleDeck.title: The Turning Wheel
fortune: The time that had slowed down for a while is about to turn again.
What you started long back will begin to move once more this week.
sampleDeck.finding: Your time is turning in your favour. How far this turn takes you is still to be read.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: How far will this turning time carry you? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Turning Wheel' card today. How will my coming time be?

sampleDeck.title: The Golden Chariot
fortune: A journey or a change of place is quietly taking shape around you.
The reins are in your own hands this week, more than you realise.
sampleDeck.finding: Movement is coming: a trip, a move, or a change. Which direction is right is still open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which direction is truly yours to take? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Golden Chariot' card today. What does it mean for travel?

sampleDeck.title: The Whole World
fortune: Your name is travelling much further than your feet ever will.
This week your work will reach good people you have never met.
sampleDeck.finding: Your world is quietly growing bigger. Which new door matters most is still to be read.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which new door is truly yours? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Whole World' card today. What new chance is coming to me?

sampleDeck.title: The Open Road
fortune: A path that felt closed for a long time is quietly opening again.
One clear step ahead will show itself to you in the coming days.
sampleDeck.finding: A way forward is opening for you. Whether to step now or wait a little is the open question.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: When will the right moment to step forward arrive? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Open Road' card today. Is this the right time to move ahead?

sampleDeck.title: The Golden Empress
fortune: What you have been saving quietly is finally starting to grow.
In the coming days money matters will begin to feel lighter.
sampleDeck.finding: Abundance is gathering around you. Where to let it flow first is what this card leaves open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Where will your savings grow best? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Golden Empress' card today. What does it mean for my money?

sampleDeck.title: The Full Home
fortune: A family matter will settle far more easily than you are expecting.
This week your house will feel fuller and warmer than it has in a while.
sampleDeck.finding: The house is moving towards peace. Who takes the first step is what this card leaves open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Who should make the first move at home? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Full Home' card today. What does it mean for my family?

sampleDeck.title: The Festive Gate
fortune: A happy occasion is quietly preparing to enter your home again.
Keep the doorway ready, because good news is already walking towards it.
sampleDeck.finding: Something worth celebrating is forming near your family. What shape it takes is still to be seen.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: What is your home truly being prepared for? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Festive Gate' card today. What good news is coming home?

sampleDeck.title: The Steady Emperor
fortune: Your steady work is being noticed by far more people than you know.
In the coming days your word will carry real weight where it matters.
sampleDeck.finding: Your standing at work is rising quietly. Where to use that voice is the open question.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: When will your voice count the most? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Steady Emperor' card today. What does it mean for my work?

sampleDeck.title: The Skilled Hand
fortune: The skill you keep practising quietly is close to paying you back.
One more honest round of effort and the result will begin to show.
sampleDeck.finding: Your craft is nearly ready to be seen. Which door to knock on first is still to be understood.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which door will open for your skill? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Skilled Hand' card today. What does it mean for my career?

sampleDeck.title: The Three Cups
fortune: Good news in the family is going to bring people together again.
This week a small celebration is already on its way to your door.
sampleDeck.finding: A happy occasion is forming around you. What it will be about is still to be seen.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: What joy is being prepared for you? Ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Three Cups' card today. What good news is coming?
